asr.full_text: The one coin provides a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity the one coin is a cryptocurrency born in the success of the Bitcoin it all started back in 2009 when the Bitcoin got introduced and traded at $10 cents per coin since then it has been trading at over $1,000 per coin, and has increased in value more than seventy five times since its introduction The one coin however is much more than a cryptocurrency It's a lifestyle concept offering unique opportunities for profitability and growth This opportunity is only available through an invitation basis and provides a business platform and a financial education platform. OneCoin has the potential to become the most attractive cryptocurrency on the market. Due to its innovative approach and usability, this can be the next Bitcoin. Through our OneAcademy, you will learn how to trade and profit from cryptocurrency. With its innovative approach and usability this can be the Next Bitcoin. Through our ONE Academy, you will learn how to trade and profit from cryptocurrency. Through our interactive materials such as videos, presentation and online quizzes. All designed to make you profit from owning cryptocurrency. Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire? You don't need any prior skills about trading. Our program is designed in five levels with a simple step-by-step approach guiding you to success. All education packages contain free one tokens. The tokens can be traded on our exchange, much like the stock market. All members profit from buying and selling tokens from each other so take this opportunity now while the price is still low and profit from the next cryptocurrency success. It's free to become a member and join one. However, if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages. Tycoon Executive Trader Pro-Trader Trader or Starter Tycoon costs € 5,000. Executive trader costs € 3, ProTrader costs €1000, Trader costs €500, and our Starter is €100! All our packages include excellent educational material from our ONE Academy! Trade for profit by low sell high trade your tokens and profit. The one tokens are included in the product packages as a free bonus. Bonus How can you make money with one? There are nine different ways to profit from our bonus programme. The direct sales bonus. The network bonus, the matching bonus, the startup bonus, one, life points. business. direct sales and network bonus. You get 10% bonus on all personal sales associated to the business volume that BV, this means for every sale you make business volume from your sales team. The member that joins your team, and with you as a sponsor, will be placed on your right and left side. You decide left or right, you can also let the system do this for you with our alternative setting. Matching Bonus The matching bonus helps you grow your team and make you successful. Depending on what package and status you have, you can earn up to generations of matching bonus and up to 25%. Startup Bonus During your first 30 days from your first purchase on a product package, you can receive an additional 10% on direct sales. So keep your momentum and build your team because the clock is ticking. One Life Points. By joining early, you can collect one life points. Here you can see how many points you can collect per day. So join now as you collect more points from the people joining after you points can be redeemed for items such as holidays luxury items and exclusive rewards split as the one tokens increase in price on our exchange you will profit not only from the price increase but moreover through the split of the token this means you double your amount of tokens after a split. By holding a Tycoon status, you can split up to two times, that means four times your money! Gold Bonus One has partnered up with a new type of cryptocurrency, a so-called hybrid currency, the first on the market to back up the currency with solid gold as a bonus you collect album gold coins each coin is backed up with one milligram of solid gold these coins you receive for free as a member of one leadership program one rewards you for being a top performer and joining our leadership program the program gives you special promotions such as cars luxury watches and other life-changing experiences so as you can see 1 provides a very attractive bonus program for you to build a successful career join today and start building your team payout conditions on this page you can read our bonus payout conditions one pays out bonuses on a weekly basis so keep track of your bonus payouts in your back office

textual.observation: The source promotes cryptocurrency-related profit and millionaire outcomes, linking those outcomes to owning tokens and purchasing product packages.

evidence.quote: Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?
if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages

textual.context: Promotional presentation for OneCoin and its educational and product packages.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised financial outcome is directly connected to purchasing packages and owning or trading the associated tokens.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the claims were accurate, whether purchases produced returns, or whether the described cryptocurrency functioned as stated.

textual.observation: The source describes bonuses and rewards connected to recruiting team members and people joining after the viewer.

textual.limitations: The supplied ASR is truncated at the end of ASR_0002, and the records do not establish actual recruitment results, payout availability, or the complete bonus conditions.

textual.potential_relevance: A specified membership status is linked to a stated multiple of money and a token-price-based profit claim.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the token price increased, whether the split changed economic value, or what was required to obtain or maintain Tycoon status.

textual.context: The claims are presented in promotional material describing bonuses and leadership-program benefits.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated asset-backing claim and free reward are linked to membership in a leadership programme and top-performer status.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the existence, quantity, value, or redeemability of the described gold, coins, promotions, or experiences.

visual.observation: A presentation describes OneCoin as a cryptocurrency that could become highly attractive and states that its success will roll out in three phases.
visual.context: Promotional presentation context is visible; the supplied frame does not show a warning, quotation, or denial.
visual.potential_relevance: The cryptocurrency value/opportunity claim is presented as part of promotion for the OneCoin concept, which conditionally merits review because it links an investment-like product claim to an asserted future outcome.
visual.limitations: This frame does not establish whether the stated potential or rollout occurred, whether viewers were asked to pay or transfer assets, or whether the claims were accurate.

visual.observation: The presentation says educational packages teach trading skills and provide an opportunity to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire; it also states that packages include free OneTokens tradable on the OneExchange and refers to members profiting from buying and selling tokens.
visual.context: The claims appear in promotional material for OneAcademy packages; no explicit warning or qualification is visible in the sampled frame.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised wealth outcome and token-trading opportunity are linked to purchasing or obtaining educational packages, creating a reward/return relationship that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish actual profits, token liquidity, payment or transfer completion, or whether the described opportunity was available as stated.

visual.observation: A product-package table lists OneAcademy packages priced at EUR 5,000 and EUR 3,000, with associated OneToken and AGC-Coin quantities and an OneCard column marked YES.
visual.context: The table is presented as a product-package offering; the sampled frame does not show payment instructions or a risk disclosure.
visual.potential_relevance: Specified package payments are connected to quantities of tokens and coins, creating a paid-access-to-digital-assets relationship that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frame does not show how payment is made, who receives funds, whether assets were delivered, or whether the listed values or benefits were realized.

visual.observation: A direct-sales and network-bonus slide states that personally generated sales receive a 10% bonus, members are placed on a left or right leg when they join with a sponsor, and 10% of accumulated business volume is paid on the weaker side.
visual.context: The slide explicitly presents a network-sales compensation structure; no warning, quotation, or denial is visible.
visual.potential_relevance: Bonus payments are linked to generating sales and joining through a sponsor or team structure, creating a recruitment/sales-linked return relationship that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish the terms of eligibility, actual payments, participant outcomes, or whether joining or recruiting was required in a particular case.

visual.observation: A matching-bonus slide says bonuses can be earned for up to four generations and up to 25%, depending on the package and status held.
visual.context: This is presented as a compensation-program description; no warning or qualification is visible in the sampled frame.
visual.potential_relevance: The claimed multigenerational bonus is tied to package and status levels, creating a tiered participation-to-reward relationship that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frame does not show how status is obtained, whether recruitment or purchases are required, or whether the stated bonuses were paid.

visual.observation: A leadership-program slide promises top performers rewards ranging from gold to watches or a car, with special promotions every three to six months.
visual.context: The reward claim is shown in promotional program material; the sampled frame does not display eligibility rules or a warning.
visual.potential_relevance: High-value rewards are linked to top performance and recurring promotional periods, creating a performance-to-reward claim that conditionally merits review.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish the performance criteria, availability, value, recipients, or whether any reward was delivered.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and encourages viewers to buy paid packages, recruit team members, and pursue bonuses tied to multi-level generations. It combines claims of cryptocurrency appreciation and becoming a millionaire with recruitment-dependent commissions, token splits, and rewards such as cars and luxury items. The presentation is an affirmative sales pitch ending with an immediate call to join, rather than reporting or criticizing the offer.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 is primary because the promoted earning structure explicitly uses sponsors, teams, left/right placement, multiple generations, and bonuses based on downstream business volume. S05 is separately supported by claims that purchasing and holding OneTokens will profit from exchange-price increases and token splits. a paid earning-guidance cue applies because paid packages are presented as access to OneAcademy education designed to enable profit from cryptocurrency trading.

evidence.observation: The promotion uses a direct wealth and millionaire appeal while presenting OneCoin as the next Bitcoin.
evidence.quote: Do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire?

evidence.observation: Profit and bonus eligibility are expressly conditioned on purchasing one of five paid packages.
evidence.quote: if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages

evidence.observation: The video describes a sponsor-based team structure with left/right placement, establishing a multi-person recruitment matrix.
evidence.quote: The member that joins your team, and with you as a sponsor, will be placed on your right and left side

evidence.observation: Matching bonuses are tied to package/status and earnings across multiple generations.
evidence.quote: Depending on what package and status you have, you can earn up to generations of matching bonus and up to 25%

evidence.observation: The paid education-package pathway is linked to receiving OneTokens, while the surrounding presentation says the materials are designed to produce profit from cryptocurrency.
evidence.quote: All education packages contain free one tokens

evidence.observation: The slide states that as more members join, demand and the price of OneTokens increase, and describes token splitting as an opportunity to double token holdings.
The closing slide displays the promotional call to action: "ONE. YOUR OPPORTUNITY. NOW."
